segments.name: Specialty Technology Solutions
segments.description: Distributes specialty technology hardware, software and subscription services through a wholesale and resale model to channel partners in the U.S. and Brazil.
segments.evidence: The Specialty Technology Solutions segment operates primarily in the United States and Brazil and includes specialty technology solutions distributed through a wholesale/resale sales model.

segments.name: Intelisys & Advisory
segments.description: Acts as a technology services distributor, selling connectivity, cloud and next-generation technologies and advisory services to partners and end users.
segments.evidence: The Intelisys & Advisory segment operates in the United States and consists of sales and services to both channel sales partners (Intelisys) and end users (Advisory).

revenueModel.text: Channel sales partners and end users pay ScanSource for technology hardware, software, connectivity, cloud services and advisory services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our channel sales partners include businesses of all sizes that sell to end users across many industries.
